title: Sequential Recovery Updates for Learned Controllers under Successful-Trajectory Preservation
summary: Matched simulated-controller tests measured a trade-off between adding recovery skills and preserving previously successful trajectories. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
